description: Itineraries, Aug. 18 - Oct. 31 1961 [three versions]; three small spiral notebooks and loose notes; two sheets of small notes; eleven pages from spiral notebook, two newspaper clippings, a message sheet, three letter-size pages of notes, three hand-drawn charts, two typed pages all concerning Typhoon Nancy, Sept. 23, 1961; seven photographs [some identified on the back] and one clipping all concerning shooting the rapids at Hozu, Japan.
title: Asian Wedding trip
